bio: Rusacks St Andrews is steeped in golfing history. This 1800's building overlooks the picturesque town of St Andrews, just a stone’s throw from Old Tom Morris’s famous Old Course Links.  Following a major renovation, Rusacks St Andrews is once again welcoming guests to enjoy a traditional Scottish Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served in 18 Restaurant, with views over the infamous St Andrews’ Swilcan Bridge and the Old Course.  Enjoy a tradtional Afternoon Tea menu, which includes a selection of artisan finger sandwiches and Highland Venison Sausage Roll. Plain and Cranberry & Orange scones are served warm, with clotted cream and preserves.  The selection of sweet treats includes Passionfruit & Coconut Éclair and Cranberry & Morello Cherry Mousse. Choose from a selection of speciality teas including Earl Grey, Jade Tips and Dragon Well.  Afternoon Tea costs £29 per per or £39 per person with a glass of Champagne.
